snippet.title: Feed The Pit - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278290/Feed_The_Pit/?utm=YouTube

WHAT IS "FEED THE PIT"?
Join the society. Avoid unpredictable horrors that will pursue you relentlessly. Perform rituals in a haunted forest to find dead bodies. Feed these bodies to THE PIT, lest you should be fed to it yourself.

CHECK OUT OUR PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/CuriousFoxSox
JOIN OUR DISCORD: https://discord.gg/hnAY7DGPcS
TWITTER (Or X if you're lame): https://x.com/curiousfoxsox

Narrator Voice - Eric True
